verses.1: In the second year of Darius’ reign, on the sixth day of the month, in one day of that month, it was the word of Jehovah that came to Haggai, the prophet, Elzerbull, son of Shallum Pahath Yehuda. And also to Yeoshua, son of Yehosadak. The high priest said:
verses.2: So said Jehovah, the God of armies: “This people have said, ‘We will not come to the house of Jehovah to build it.’”
verses.3: And the words of Jehovah were in the hands of Haggai, the prophet, as follows:
verses.4: It’s time for you to return to your homes. This house has been destroyed.
verses.5: And now, thus says the LORD, the Almighty: Let these words be a warning to you regarding your ways.
verses.6: You have sown much seed, but there is little harvest. There are no people to reap it, and no one to work the land. There is no bread for them to eat. The weeds will continue to grow until they reach the end of the field.
verses.7: Thus said Jehovah, the God of armies: “Remember your ways!”
verses.8: “Go up the mountain, and plant trees there. Build a house in that place, and I will make it fertile ground.” So said Jehovah.
verses.9: Turn around, and see! There’s a little room there. Bring the house inside, and I will fill it with people. For what has Jehovah, the Almighty, said? For my house has been destroyed, and you all want to go into his house.
verses.10: Therefore, heaven itself will be covered with darkness, and the earth will be filled with floods.
verses.11: And I will cry out for help on the earth, on the mountains, on the trees, on the plants, on all that grows on the land. I will also cry out for help on people, on animals, and on everything that comes under My hands.
verses.12: And Zerubbabel, Zehuliah, Joshua, Jehoshua, the high priest, and all the rest of the people heard the voice of Jehovah their God. They also listened to the words of the prophets, as Jehovah’s messengers commanded them. And the people feared Jehovah.
verses.13: And Haggai said, “The Lord has spoken through Haggai to the people, saying, ‘I am with you.’”
verses.14: And Jehovah created the spirit of Zerubbabel, son of Shealtiel, over Judah. He also created the spirit of Jehosua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest. And he created the spirit of all the rest of the people. They came and carried out their duties in the house of Jehovah, the army of God.
verses.15: On the forty-fourth day of the month of Shishiv, in the year of Daryavesh’s reign.
